view: Wide oblique view Lothal long rectangular empty excavated brick-lined basin, low eroded walls and inlet opening, dry basin floor and low settlement platform beyond, no modern ocean ships or intact harbor reconstruction.

eras.title: A basin beside the settlement
eras.caption: Lothal's excavated brick-lined basin has long been interpreted as a dock connected with trade. Alongside the town's streets and craft remains, it shows how this Indus settlement was shaped by water and exchange.
